parts.name: Sphere
parts.Basic_description: This is the spherical part of the globe made of plastic, representing the Earth’s surface with geographical details.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the main display surface for the map of the world and can rotate around its axis for viewing different regions.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate freely around the tilted axis supported by the base body.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the supporting structure of the globe, made of plastic, consisting of the stand and the semi-circular arm holding the sphere.
parts.Functional_description: It provides stability to the globe and supports the axis that allows the sphere to rotate smoothly.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during normal use, serving as a fixed support.
